𝗟𝗲𝗲𝘁𝗖𝗼𝗱𝗲 𝗶𝘀𝗻’𝘁 𝗷𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝘀𝗼𝗹𝘃𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗹𝗲𝗺𝘀.
It’s about learning how to think.
𝗗𝗼𝗻’𝘁 𝗷𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝘀𝗼𝗹𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀-𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗺.
→ Why does this approach work?
→ What patterns can I recognize?
→ How can I apply this thinking elsewhere?
The real value isn’t in getting the right answer.
It’s in building the problem-solving intuition that makes future challenges easier.
𝗪𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗹𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹 𝘂𝗽?
📌 Study different approaches, even if you got the answer right.
📌 Re-solve problems in new ways-recursive vs. iterative, brute force vs. optimized.
📌 Push yourself with harder problems.
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗯𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀?
🚀 Platforms: LeetCode, Codeforces, AtCoder.
📚 Books: “Introduction to Algorithms” (Cormen) never gets old.
🤝 Communities: Learn with others—it speeds up growth.
𝗖𝗼𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗮 𝘀𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹.
But problem-solving? That’s a superpower.
